name: Aisai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Aisai city emblem in green, blue and red: a green stylised figure above a blue swirl, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Aisai, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2005.

features.role: Aisai city emblem — a green stylised figure above a blue swirl, with a red disc
